# Copied sources

Where every piece of copied code came from. The Zed block is regenerated by
`scripts/vendor_zed.py`; edit the other sections by hand.

## Goose

Commit `b23d21cabd9b4de0c045dcdd731821a3a15c2bfc` from https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose
(Apache-2.0). Copied once on 2026-10-31 and adapted; not re-synced automatically.

| Goose source | hermes-rs location | Changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/goose-provider-types/src/` | `crates/llm/src/` | Kept only the OpenAI chat-completions format (removed anthropic, databricks, google, ollama, openai_responses, snowflake). Restored the thinking-signature retry check inline in `retry.rs`. 7 image-path tests ignored on Windows (`/`-rooted paths only). |
| `crates/goose-provider-types/build.rs` | `crates/llm/build.rs` | none |
| `crates/goose-provider-types/src/canonical/data/canonical_models.json` | `crates/llm/src/canonical/data/canonical_models.json` | Trimmed (Phase 14 CP14.2): 1,371 of 8,744 rows, 10 fields; `scripts/trim-model-registry.py`. The mapping report and `provider_metadata.json` are deleted. |
| `crates/goose-providers/src/{api_client,http_status,openai_compatible}.rs` | `crates/llm/src/` | Removed the Responses API streaming path. |
| `crates/goose-agent/src/` | `crates/agent/src/` | `goose_provider_types` → `hermes_llm`; `ToolOperation::run` executes a response's tool calls concurrently (`join_all`) instead of one by one. Phase 14 CP14.1 deleted the unused `skills` (with its `goose-sdk-types` copy) and `subagent` modules, the typed-tool registration and every `wasm32` branch. |
| `crates/goose/src/agents/state_machine/ops_{empty_response,exit_on_error,maxturns,remaining_tool_calls}.rs` | `crates/runtime/src/ops.rs` | Adapted to our session/effect types; max turns doesn't fire on a finished answer; unanswered calls name the available tools. |
| — | `crates/llm/src/discovery.rs` | New (hermes-rs): model discovery from `/models` with catalog fallback. |
| `crates/goose-context-management/src/` | (deleted) | Was `crates/agent/src/compaction/`; never called (the runtime has its own compression, `crates/runtime/src/compress.rs`), deleted in Phase 14 CP14.1. |

## async-task (Zed fork)

Commit `015845a19fc31752c02367567d3b8900a406f9da` from https://github.com/zed-industries/async-task
(Apache-2.0 OR MIT), in `vendor/async-task`. Used through `[patch.crates-io]` because GPUI's
scheduler depends on the fork's changes.

## GPUI Kit

`gpui-kit` **0.10.0** from crates.io (https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit, Apache-2.0), a
dependency of `crates/native`, pinned `=0.10.0` (the exception to "copy, never depend" in
AGENTS.md ground rule 3; upgrade on purpose, like a Hermes update). Not copied: it is an ordinary
locked dependency. It brings `gpui-base` 0.10.0, `gpui-component` 0.10.0, `gpui-kit-assets` 0.10.0
and GPUI as the `gpui-pre*` crates **0.3.12**, "a gpui-pre snapshot of zed@d2a4fb6" (Zed commit
`d2a4fb6`, per `gpui-pre`'s description); the vendored Zed above is `ba63a022`, a different commit.
Features: `syntect` (code highlighting; the `tree-sitter` features clash with `crates/highlight`,
see `crates/native/Cargo.toml`). The workspace's `[patch.crates-io]` for `async-task` applies to
`gpui-pre-scheduler` too, so GPUI Kit's GPUI runs on Zed's async-task fork while `crates/app`
exists.

`crates/native` also depends directly on **`gpui-pre-wgpu` =0.3.12** (the same snapshot, already
in the lock through GPUI Kit), only under its `snapshots` feature, for the off-screen renderer the
snapshot tests use on Windows (`gpui-pre-platform` wires it on Linux only; docs/PITFALLS.md,
*Native UI*). Its `wgpu-hal` needs `gpu-allocator` built against `windows` 0.62; that entry in
`Cargo.lock` was set by hand (CP0.2).

## Themes and fonts bundled in `crates/native/assets/` (CP2.1)

- `assets/themes/one/one.json` and `assets/themes/ayu/ayu.json`: Zed's One (its port of Atom's
  One; MIT, copyright 2014 GitHub Inc., per `LICENSE` beside it) and Ayu (MIT, copyright 2016
  Ike Ku) theme families, theme data rather than code, copied unchanged from the repo's
  `assets/themes/` (which `scripts/vendor_zed.py` fills from the vendored Zed). Gruvbox is not
  bundled: its licence file in Zed's tree still has the `<YEAR> <COPYRIGHT HOLDER>` placeholders.
- `assets/fonts/inter/`: Inter 4.001, static Regular, Bold, Italic and Bold Italic (SIL OFL 1.1,
  `OFL.txt`; copyright The Inter Project Authors), unmodified, taken from t3code's client bundle.
  Decision record: `crates/native/src/theme/fonts.rs`.
